return_policy.closing.message: Would you like help requesting a return?

return_policy.facts.message:
📋 Return conditions:
• You can request a return within 24 hours of receiving the item
• The item must keep its original packaging and labels
• Fresh items must stay refrigerated or frozen

📝 How to apply:
1. On a completed order, tap the product rating, open the rating page, and go to After-sales service at the top right
2. Upload photos of the item, enter the reason for the return, and tap Submit
3. Wait for the seller to review your request
4. Once approved, a refund is arranged

⏰ Refund time:
• Credit card: 7-14 business days
• ATM transfer: 3-5 business days
